summary: Manono territory (Tanganyika) is assessed as state-held. Manono town, the lithium-mining territorial seat, and Ankoro are under territorial administration with PNC policing and FARDC posts. The southern Kiyambi secteur (Shamwana/Kabobo/Kishale toward Mitwaba and Pweto), the historic Bakata Katanga 'triangle', is assessed FARDC-held but contested by raiding Mai-Mai amid the 2025-2026 Katanga Mai-Mai resurgence. The rest of Kiyambi (Kiambi, Mukebo, Mambwe) and the western rural secteurs are default state presence with possible Twa-militia or Mai-Mai raids. Web research was blocked for this unit (search budget exhausted, news sites unreachable); sources are reused from neighbouring-unit assessments and confidence is low outside the towns.

zones.description: Manono town (territory seat, lithium mining hub): Kauluminono, HGR, Cité, St Joseph neighbourhoods, Barzin/Mazyondo and peri-urban Jerusalema/Bondo/Kameshi
zones.evidence: Territory headquarters with territorial administration, PNC commissariat and an FARDC presence guarding the Manono lithium/tin concessions; no source reports an armed group holding or administering the town. The 2024-2026 Bakata Katanga resurgence cited Manono among affected territories, but incidents are rural. Live web research was unavailable for this unit.

zones.description: Ankoro town (Nsange/Kisiko, Luvua-Lualaba confluence, Ankoro health-zone seat)
zones.evidence: Secteur/health-zone seat with state administration and police; no reports of armed-group control. Ankoro saw Mai-Mai and Twa-Luba violence in the 2000s-2010s but no recent reports of militia control were found. Default state presence.

zones.description: Kiambi town and its immediate surroundings (Kiambi, Secteur, Mpweto, Mafinge, Kamakumbi) - Kiyambi secteur seat on the Luvua
zones.evidence: Kiambi is the secteur and health-zone seat with police and army posts and was a focus of the Twa-Luba conflict and Mai-Mai activity in 2016-2020; no source found of armed-group control of the town in 2025-2026. Low confidence given lack of accessible recent reporting.

zones.description: Southern Kiyambi secteur (Shamwana, Kabobo, Monga, Lenge, Kishale, Nkonkole, Kahongo, Kalamata, Mpiana, Kabunda health areas) - northern edge of the Manono-Mitwaba-Pweto 'triangle'
zones.evidence: Historic Mai-Mai (Gédéon/Bakata Katanga) heartland bordering Mitwaba and Pweto, where Bakata Katanga attacks resumed in 2025-2026 (Kyubo, Nkonga, Lusinga in Mitwaba; Mwenge axis in Pweto; Manono cited by the government in April 2025). No source shows a militia governing these villages; the FARDC is assumed the main force with militia raids and movement in the bush.

zones.description: Rest of Kiyambi secteur and Kiambi health zone: northern (Mukebo, Kabeke, Lwaba, Kabonzo, Soswa, Kabombo, Kitentu, Mbayo) and eastern (Mambwe/Katonge carrière, Kayumba, Kazingu, Nsange) areas toward Nyunzu and Moba, plus Manono-secteur villages in Kiambi HZ
zones.evidence: Rural area with thin state presence (PNC posts, customary chiefs); historically affected by Twa militias and Luba 'Elements' (2016-2019) and bordering western Moba where Bakata Katanga made an incursion at Kamena in late Sept 2026. No source found showing an armed group durably ruling these villages; default state presence with raiding risk.

zones.description: Rural Manono and Ankoro secteurs (Manono, Ankoro, Kitenge, Kabalo and Lwamba health-zone villages along the Lualaba/Luvua and the Manono-Ankoro-Kitenge roads)
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group control in the western rural secteurs in 2025-2026; Bakata Katanga activity is reported further south-east (Mitwaba, Malemba-Nkulu, Kiambi south). Villages are under customary chiefs with thin PNC/state presence.
